Free throws: binomial probability罚球：二项概率

A coach models one player's ten free throws as independent trials, each with success probability 0.70. Follow the fixed model from question to calculation to a conclusion with the correct scope.教练把一名球员的十次罚球建模为相互独立的试验，单次命中概率 0.70。沿固定模型从明确问题、完成计算到给出适用范围恰当的结论。

Data and calculator assumption数据与计算器假设

Synthetic educational model created for this course: ten independent free throws with success probability 0.70 per shot. No external observations or real player records.本课程编制的合成教学模型：十次独立罚球，单次命中概率 0.70；不含外部观测或真实球员记录。

Assumption: TI-84 Plus CE, OS 5.7, MathPrint on, STAT WIZARDS off. Text values below are rounded transcriptions, not exact screen formatting.假设：TI-84 Plus CE，OS 5.7，MathPrint 开启，STAT WIZARDS 关闭。下列数值为四舍五入后的文字转录，不表示屏幕的精确排版。

This is a worked process, with rounded numeric transcriptions. It is not a calculator emulator or screen image. Conceptual checks are labeled separately.这是逐步讲解，数值为四舍五入后的文字转录，并非计算器模拟器或屏幕截图。概念核验单独标注。

Use ← and → to step. Printing includes every step in the selected language.使用 ← 和 → 逐步浏览。打印时显示所选语言的全部步骤。

1. Define the question1. 明确问题

Conceptual setup概念设置

Question: in ten independent free throws with success probability 0.70, what is the probability of exactly eight makes, and of at least eight makes?问题：在十次独立罚球、单次命中概率 0.70 的情况下，恰好命中八次与至少命中八次的概率各是多少？

X = number of makes in 10 shots; events X = 8 and X ≥ 8X = 10 次罚球中的命中次数；事件 X = 8 与 X ≥ 8

State the variable, the model inputs, and the scope first. The probability describes the long-run behavior of this model, not a promise for one sequence of ten shots.先说明变量、模型参数与适用范围。该概率描述模型的长期行为，并不保证某一次十球序列的结果。

2. Check the binomial conditions2. 检查二项分布条件

Conceptual check概念核验

Four conditions: fixed number of trials (n = 10); two outcomes per trial (make or miss); constant success probability (p = 0.70); independent trials.四个条件：试验次数固定（n = 10）；每次只有两种结果（命中或未中）；单次命中概率恒定（p = 0.70）；各次试验相互独立。

Model: X ~ B(10, 0.70), where X counts made free throws模型：X ~ B(10, 0.70)，X 为命中的罚球数

The value 0.70 is a model assumption for this synthetic player. If makes and misses influenced each other, the binomial model would not apply.0.70 是本合成示例球员的模型假设。若命中与否相互影响，二项模型就不再适用。

3. Compute the mean and standard deviation3. 计算均值与标准差

Formula check公式核验

Mean: μ = np. Variance: σ² = np(1-p). Standard deviation: σ = √(np(1-p)).均值：μ = np；方差：σ² = np(1-p)；标准差：σ = √(np(1-p))。

μ = 10(0.70) = 7 made throws; σ² = 2.1; σ = √2.1 ≈ 1.4491μ = 10(0.70) = 7 次命中；σ² = 2.1；σ = √2.1 ≈ 1.4491

These are properties of the model, not of one observed sequence. A typical ten-shot run lands about 1.45 makes away from 7.这些是模型的属性，而非某一次观测序列的结果。典型的十球序列与 7 的偏差约为 1.45 次。

4. Compute the probability of exactly eight4. 计算恰好命中八次的概率

TI-84 keys and transcriptionTI-84 按键与转录

2ND VARS (DISTR) → scroll to A:binompdf( → ENTER. Type binompdf(10,0.70,8) → ENTER.2ND VARS（DISTR）→ 滚动到 A:binompdf( → ENTER。输入 binompdf(10,0.70,8) → ENTER。

binompdf(10,0.70,8) = .2334744405, so P(X = 8) ≈ 0.2335binompdf(10,0.70,8) = .2334744405，故 P(X = 8) ≈ 0.2335

Argument order is n, p, x. Omitting x returns the full list of probabilities for x = 0..10, which is easy to misread as a single value.参数顺序为 n、p、x。省略 x 会返回 x = 0..10 的全部概率列表，很容易被误读为单个数值。

5. Compute the probability of at least eight5. 计算至少命中八次的概率

TI-84 keys and transcriptionTI-84 按键与转录

2ND VARS (DISTR) → B:binomcdf( → ENTER. Type 1-binomcdf(10,0.70,7) → ENTER.2ND VARS（DISTR）→ B:binomcdf( → ENTER。输入 1-binomcdf(10,0.70,7) → ENTER。

1-binomcdf(10,0.70,7) = .38278279, so P(X ≥ 8) ≈ 0.38281-binomcdf(10,0.70,7) = .38278279，故 P(X ≥ 8) ≈ 0.3828

binomcdf(n, p, x) gives P(X ≤ x). The complement covers X = 8, 9, and 10 in one step; equivalently, add the three pdf values.binomcdf(n, p, x) 给出 P(X ≤ x)。补事件一步覆盖 X = 8、9、10；也可以把三个 pdf 值相加。

6. Interpret within the model6. 在模型范围内解释

Conceptual conclusion概念结论

Report the probability, the model, and the scope.报告概率、模型与适用范围。

Under B(10, 0.70), about 23.3% of ten-shot sequences make exactly eight, and about 38.3% make at least eight.在 B(10, 0.70) 模型下，约 23.3% 的十球序列恰好命中八次，约 38.3% 至少命中八次。

The probabilities describe the model's long-run behavior. The 0.70 input was assumed, so no conclusion extends to every player or situation.这些概率描述模型的长期行为。0.70 为假设参数，结论不能推广到所有球员或情形。
